# ContextForge
> The local-first AI workspace desktop application built on Tauri v2 (Rust).

## Core Architecture
- Desktop Binary: Built with Rust + Tauri v2 (Windows, macOS, Linux).
- Inference: Universal BYOK supporting Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and offline localhost Ollama.
- Guardrails: Non-blocking prompt queue, pre-mutation Time Machine disk snapshots, and per-hunk diff inspection.
- Privacy: 100% local workspace code. Zero telemetry. Zero remote workspace indexing.
- Distribution: Standalone releases hosted via GitHub Releases.
